# Space 3D Site

> Open-source Three.js / WebGL demo by Ryan Editraj: a pizza planet, a neon wireframe donut, a floating cube, and a duck beak in one HTML page. No build step and no API keys.

Space 3D Site is a static creative-coding project from a first Hack Club exercise. The scene lives in `js/scene.js` and uses Three.js r128 from cdnjs, pinned with subresource integrity. The pizza texture is a local JPEG at `assets/textures/pizza.jpg`. The visible headline still reads "WELCOME TO MY EPIC 3D DUCK PIZZA WORLD!!! OMG (My first Hackclub)".

The cone stands in for a duck beak. Materials are `MeshBasicMaterial`, so the ambient light does not shade the meshes. The loop starts on its own. There is no account system and no server.

## Source

- [Scene](https://github.com/ryaneditraj/Space-3d-site/blob/main/js/scene.js): geometries, materials, and the animation loop
- [Page](https://github.com/ryaneditraj/Space-3d-site/blob/main/index.html): document, meta tags, and structured data
- [Styles](https://github.com/ryaneditraj/Space-3d-site/blob/main/css/styles.css): the original purple, lime, yellow, and red overlay
